messages:
Priya M: Quick heads up 10: Acora flagged retention mismatch: customer wants 2-year embeddings retention; our default is 90 days. They marked it as a deal-critical question for renewal.
Diego R: If they need 2 years well need to offer a paid retention add-on and update the retention policy docs.
Sam C: Agree. Also need to check if processors/subprocessors are affected. Diego, can you check infra capacity and egress cost estimate for 2-year retention?
Legal-Bot: Auto-note: any custom retention commitments >=1 year must be routed to Legal for contract language and Data Processing Addendum update. See: https://redwood.internal/legal/retention-guidance
infra-bot: Cost estimate job queued: `./jobs/estimate-retention --days 730 --model=embed-v1 --account=Acora`
Diego R: Estimate shows ~+35% storage cost and an incremental retrieval cost. I'll attach spreadsheet when ready. ETA 12h.
Priya M: Draft reply to Acora below, pls review:

```
Hi Mark,

Thanks for the question. Our standard embedding retention is 90 days. We can accommodate a 2-year retention as a paid add-on or under an enterprise retention amendment. Next steps:

1) Please confirm business justification for 2-year retention (e.g., fraud detection, long-term search).
2) We'll provide a formal quote and updated retention clause for the DPA.
3) If accepted, we will schedule onboarding with engineering for export/import of historical embeddings.

We aim to provide the quote within 48hrs after confirmation. Let us know if you'd like an interim solution (e.g., export buckets) while contract is finalized.

Best,
Priya on behalf of Redwood CS
```
Sam C: Add: include note about potential quality drift for embeddings if models/quantization change over time and recommend periodic re-embedding.
Diego R: Also: note that retrieval performance may degrade for very large indexes; we suggest sharding and cold storage tiering.
Priya M: Noted. Legal will add DPA clause draft after Diego posts cost. Scheduling internal sync in 6h.
Sam C: I'll prepare privacy-safe export option for interim. ETA 24h.
Priya M: Thanks team. Mark in Acora is expecting a response in 48h; tracking under renewal-watch. :eyes:
